Class TableGui

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.client.gui.TableGui
public class TableGui extends Object
Controller for the main game table scene.
Manages card rows, buildings, tiles, and player panels.
Delegates tribe and leaderboard views to TribeGui and LeaderboardGui.
